title: Enterprise Retail Chain Store Site Selection, Geo-Spatial LBS Huff Gravity Model, Cannibalization Forecasting & Commercial Lease Review Agent

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Broker Intuition + Static 1km Euclidean Ring Excel
tiers.architecture: Field real-estate brokers manually tallying foot traffic + static 1km circular census buffer (ignoring rivers/highways/barriers) + manual 90-page lease reading

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Prompt-Only General LLM Neighborhood Recommender
tiers.architecture: Prompting GPT-4o / Claude with street addresses and asking for predicted store revenue and lease summary without spatial LBS telemetry or gravity math

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Generic Tabular Census Regression (No Isochrone/Huff)
tiers.architecture: Standard GBDT trained on ZIP-code demographics without walk-time isochrones, turn-side storefront visibility VLM, or sister-store Huff gravity transfer

tiers.tier: Tier 4: H3 Spatial Isochrone + Huff Gravity Cannibalization + Storefront VLM + Lease Clause AST Agent
tiers.architecture: Uber H3 Res-9 Hexagonal LBS Grid + Travel-Time Isochrone Huff Gravity + Street-View Storefront Visibility VLM + Commercial Lease Co-Tenancy/CAM/Exclusivity AST Gate

scenarios.scenario: Railway/River Physical Barrier Trap (Store 400m Straight-Line from CBD Office Tower)
scenarios.question: A candidate café site is 400m Euclidean distance from a 25,000-worker tech park, separated by a fenced rail corridor requiring an 18-minute walk detour
scenarios.model_answer: Compute OSRM/Valhalla pedestrian travel-time isochrone over H3 Res-9 hexagons; discount across-barrier H3 cells by 94% decay exp(-beta * t_walk)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 1 static 1km circle counts all 25,000 workers as prime customers, overpredicting Year-1 sales by +68% and triggering a $450K CapEx store closure.

scenarios.scenario: Sister-Store Sales Transfer / Cannibalization Check (Opening Store B 850m from Flagship Store A)
scenarios.question: Predict net incremental revenue vs. cannibalized sales diverted from existing Store A ($1.8M/yr) when opening candidate Store B along the same commuter corridor
scenarios.model_answer: Run calibrated Huff Gravity utility model P_ij = (A_j^alpha * D_ij^-beta) / sum_k(A_k^alpha * D_ik^-beta) across shared H3 origin hexagons; flag 38% cannibalization ($684K transfer)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 3 independent store regression predicts $1.4M gross sales for Store B while ignoring that $684K is stolen directly from Store A (net NPV negative).

scenarios.scenario: Street-View Micro-Location Visibility & Commuter Side-of-Street Asymmetry
scenarios.question: Two storefronts sit across the same 6-lane divided arterial road with a median barrier; North side has recessed arcade pillars blocking signage
scenarios.model_answer: Extract storefront frontage width, setback occlusion, and morning-commute right-hand turn ingress via Street-View VLM into spatial XGBoost features
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 3 ZIP/H3 macro model treats both sides of the street identically, missing a 32% foot-traffic capture penalty from recessed pillars and median barrier.

scenarios.scenario: Commercial Lease Co-Tenancy, CAM Cap & Competitor Exclusivity Clause AST Audit
scenarios.question: Audit an 85-page shopping mall lease where landlord removed the '5% annual controllable CAM cap' and weakened anchor Co-Tenancy remedies
scenarios.model_answer: Parse lease into Clause AST; block execution on uncapped Common Area Maintenance (CAM), missing direct-competitor exclusivity, or 24-month cure delay on anchor vacancy
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 2 prompt summary misses the deleted controllable CAM cap buried in Exhibit C, exposing the store to a +28% year-2 occupancy cost surge.

key_findings: Tier 4 (H3 Travel-Time Isochrone + Huff Gravity Cannibalization + Storefront VLM + Lease Clause AST) slashes Year-1 store revenue MAPE from 34.5% to 6.4% and sister-store cannibalization error from 28.0% to 2.8%.
Replacing Euclidean circular buffers with OSRM/Valhalla travel-time isochrones over Uber H3 Res-9 hexagons eliminates physical-barrier illusions (rivers, railways, divided highways).

Pairing spatial revenue underwriting with a deterministic Commercial Lease Clause AST Gate catches 100% of uncapped CAM, missing competitor exclusivity, and weak anchor co-tenancy clauses, cutting monthly underwriting + bad-location CapEx loss from $410K to $38K (-90.7%).
